notes.title: Dumbriel Wins National Showcase Award at Digital Dragons Gala 2024!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Adventurers,[/h2]

We have some fantastic news to share with you all!

Our game, [b]Dumbriel: Magnificent Adventure in Hell[/b], is currently in its early development stage. In this stage, we have created an introductory version that showcases Dumbriel's origins, his exploration of heaven, and the pivotal actions that led to his dramatic fall into hell. This version focuses on the storyline, featuring stunning game animations, distinctive art style, and fluid movements, giving players a taste of the platforming mechanics to come.


[b]Highlights from Digital Dragons 2024[/b]


[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44391691/c8a5dcca5ce36e43db983224fc11e6693c983449.png[/img]

We had the honor of representing Dumbriel at the Digital Dragons 2024 event, where we shared our vision with fellow developers, publishers, and investors. The feedback was overwhelmingly positive, and we are delighted to announce that Dumbriel: Magnificent Adventure in Hell was awarded the [b]National Showcase Award at the Digital Dragons Gala 2024![/b] This recognition was a delightful surprise for us, and we couldn't have been happier when our game's name was announced. Standing on stage, we were almost speechless with excitement and gratitude.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44391691/e4f340276c92132078a31720277c6bd48c11eee4.jpg[/img]


[b]Engaging with the Industry[/b]
During the event, we engaged in numerous discussions with potential publishers and investors. Their enthusiasm for our game was incredibly encouraging. We are continuing these conversations, exploring business opportunities to bring Dumbriel's adventure to life on a grand scale.

[b]A Heartfelt Thank You[/b]
We extend our deepest gratitude to the entire Digital Dragons team for organizing such a productive and inspiring event. Your efforts in making this one of the top conferences in the industry are truly appreciated.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44391691/daa239735d66556661fca07cbd4b2306d9eeaca7.jpg[/img]

Thank you to our community for the support. Stay tuned for more updates as we continue to develop Dumbriel: Magnificent Adventure in Hell. Exciting times are ahead, and we can’t wait to share them with you!

Best regards,

The Dumbriel Development Team
